q: How do I calculate emissions for a hydrogen fuel cell bus?
title: Hydrogen fuel cell bus emissions
short: The bus emits only water, so the footprint lies in the hydrogen. Multiply kg of hydrogen used per km by the CO2 per kg from its production: high for hydrogen from natural gas, low for electrolysis on renewable power. Ask the supplier for that figure.
audience: City transport operators trialling fuel cell buses

p: No Scope 1 from the bus itself. Emissions from producing bought hydrogen sit in Scope 3 Category 3. If you make hydrogen on site, the electricity or gas you use is Scope 2 or Scope 1.
Set a diesel or electric bus beside it on the same route, with the same km and passengers, before claiming a saving.

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.
